headings.text: At 80% we tell you You get an email and a note on your dashboard with how many prescriptions are left this month.
At 100% new ones pause You cannot issue new prescriptions until the 1st. Links already sent still open, and patients can still pay.
Upgrade and carry on Move up a plan at any time. You pay only the difference for the days left in the month.

findings.fix: A page needs about five: display, heading, lead, body, small.

findings.message: The margins differ: 40px on the left, 66px on the right, at 1440px.
findings.fix: Put the navigation and the content on one pair of margins; check for padding on one side only, a scrollbar gutter, or a header on another inset than the page.
Check that it is a deliberate rest (once per page at most); otherwise close it to the normal section gap.

findings.message: 4 headline(s) switch typeface or to italic mid-line (the "one italic serif word" move).
findings.fix: Set the whole headline in one face. Emphasis comes from the words.
